title: bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain: six-class GLV rho, 148-instruction object regenerated with its manifest and claim, corrected attack-level success meter (emitted fallback abandons -> 0; repaired design 0.36624), true-multiplicity allowances, 126.2433

claims.statement: Claim (time_log2 = 126.2433): for a uniform challenge T=[x]P0 in BLS12-381 G1 (T=infinity returns 0), the algorithm of proof.md recovers x. Its total work is at most 2^126.2433 batched-incomplete-affine-G1-addition equivalents (one unit = C = 2,000 scalar AArch64 instructions; the organizer's fixed 6M normalization, unchanged), enforced by a global meter that charges every action at an upper-bound price before executing it and halts with failure at the claim. The shipped span is one single-entry function of 148 object instructions: 132 charged literal rows in emit order plus 16 synthetic lines (two returns and five three-instruction exit stubs), 1:1 with the object in order, __text = 0x250 = 4 x 148 bytes ending at the last instruction, zero unattributed instructions (completeness.py; three planted enumeration defects each detected). The charge is 131 per non-refresh element (129 literal + 2 amortised per-batch rows: meter and Fermat share) and 134 on the 1-in-64 refresh step (131 + 3 refresh stores); the 64-cycle mean is 131.046875 and the level price is 1.0655234375. Every record field is read before its own first write: offsets 0, 16, 32, 48, 64, 80, 96, 104, 120, 136 are loaded, in emitted order, before the first store to each (10/10, extraction in regen-report.txt); the property is per-field, not the false v32 claim that coordinates are read before the checkpoint/length fields. The canonicalisation fallback is an exit stub whose body is ldur x30, [sp, #8]; add sp, sp, #16; ret - it RETURNS, so a fallback abandons the batch. The fast truncated-product index falls back with structural probability at most 2^-59 per canonicalisation (the 32-value near-tie window 32/2^64, plus the 33/2^125 wrap window); over S_ops = 2^126.15 steps the expected number of falls is 2^-59 * 2^126.15 = 2^67.15, so the produced object is abandoned with probability 1-exp(-2^67.15) = 1 and its success probability is 0.00000, not 0.39. The Part-A populations are reported separately: 0/30,000 random inputs and 2,172/10,000 adversarial near-tie inputs fell back; v33's mixed 2,172/40,000 = 5.43% is withdrawn as a production rate because the adversarial population is not a sample of the walk. Success-side terms are attack-level, each arithmetic line shown: more than 8 processed matches 0.62^8 = 0.021834 (charged, not 2^-18); length cap e^-20 = 2.0612e-9 per trail x 2^20 open trails = 0.00216128 (union bound, no independence assumed); report table 2^-18; recovery 2^-30; meter 0.000059. With a per-element exact-index fallback path (proof.md 9.5) the design success would be 0.36624, still below 0.39; that path is NOT in the shipped object. The 0.39 floor is therefore refuted for the shipped object, not merely open. Work side: phase 1 = 1.0655234375*(S_ops+2^60) = 2^126.241548, headroom 2^116.55, meter early-halt 0.000059. Allowances carry their true multiplicities and executed prices: fresh trail [a]P0+[b]T at the executed scalar-mult chain (1045.75 units) x S_ops/theta = 2^62.15 trials; report lookup + sort share + transfer at 768 instructions per report x 2^62.15 reports; completion of one capped trail (20*2^64*1.0655234375) x the 2^20 open trails; 8 matches x 2 trails x the cap for re-walks; verification and output. Total 4.122e+26 units = 2^88.41, i.e. 2^-37.8 of the phase-1 base, charged inside the claim; the claim covers base + allowances. The score is 1262433/10000 in lowest terms (gcd 1). Peak memory is below 2^72 bytes. H1 (disclosed heuristic): within S_ops class arrivals of all trails the first inter-trail collision has occurred with probability at least 1-exp(-(S_ops/1.015)^2/(2N')) = 0.3903 (random-mapping law, 1.5% slowdown allowance); the toy pipeline at n=3000 gives 0.3897, CP-95 [0.3722, 0.4072] at toy scope only. No production-size run. The v33 `esc2_events` statistic is deleted: its counter was initialised and never incremented, so its zero count was not evidence of anything.

experiments.purpose: Part A: production algebra on BLS12-381 G1 (GLV pair, orbit size 6, |y| key, canonical member, section-1.1 truncated-product index against the exact rule on 30,000 random + 10,000 adversarial near-tie inputs, twisted step, doubling class map, coefficient tracking, forced-merge recovery), reporting the random and adversarial fallback populations separately. Part B: the scaled pipeline on a toy curve at n=3000 in a budget-safe run (seconds=240, returns a dump inside the judge's 300 s attempt). The cost block recomputes the attack-level success terms and the true-multiplicity allowances; v34 prices the emitted fallback as batch abandonment and states success 0.
